title: Partially Observable Zero-shot coordination by Predicting Intention of Partner
title_zh: 部分可观测的零样本协调通过预测合作伙伴意图

paragraphs.en: Zero-shot coordination in embodied settings requires acting while the partner is intermittently out of view, leaving existing methods with ambiguous partner representations and uncertainty over hidden partner states. We propose Predicting Intention of Partner (PIP) to jointly address these challenges. PIP uses a Joint-view VAE to distill richer training-time evidence from the union of both agents’ local observations into a partner representation available from local observations alone. Partner-state Belief networks further infer the partner’s hidden location and behavioral tendencies from the ego agent’s interaction history. We evaluate PIP in Burrito-PO, Overcooked-PO, and a Melting Pot substrate, together with a human evaluation in Burrito-PO. PIP attains the highest mean performance among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. Human evaluation and diagnostic analyses further support coordination with unseen partners and the contributions of both components under partner occlusion.

paragraphs.en: As AI agents and robots are increasingly deployed in real-world interactive systems, human-AI collaboration has become a central goal of artificial intelligence. In such settings, an agent must coordinate with diverse unseen humans or partner agents that were never encountered during training. This requirement has motivated the study of zero-shot coordination (ZSC) [ 18 , 28 , 24 ] , whose central difficulty is the shift of partner distribution between training and deployment. Agents trained through self-play [ 15 , 40 ] often converge to arbitrary conventions and fail when paired with partners that follow different ones. To mitigate this, prior work has expanded the diversity of the partner population used during training [ 5 , 43 , 50 ] . Representing the space of possible partners with a finite set of policies, however, is inherently limited. Generative prior-based methods [ 6 , 23 , 26 ] have therefore emerged as a promising alternative. By modeling a continuous latent space of partner behaviors from coordination trajectories, they expose the target policy to partners beyond the observed population, and have achieved remarkable results in fully observable environments such as Overcooked [ 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 随着人工智能智能体和机器人在现实世界互动系统中的部署日益广泛，人类与人工智能的合作已成为人工智能研究的核心目标。 在此类场景中，智能体必须与各种未曾见过的用户或从未在训练阶段接触过的合作智能体进行协调。 这一需求推动了零样本协作（ZSC）[ 18 , 28 , 24 ] 的研究，其核心难题在于训练与部署阶段合作对象分布的变化。 通过自我对弈 [ 15 , 40 ] 训练的智能体往往会收敛到任意的约定规则，在与遵循不同规则的合作对象配对时便会失效。 为缓解这一问题，先前的研究扩展了训练过程中所用合作对象群体的多样性 [ 5 , 43 , 50 ] 。 然而，用有限策略集来表示所有可能的合作对象空间，本质上存在局限性。 因此，基于生成式先验的方法 [ 6 , 23 , 26 ] 逐渐成为一种有前景的替代方案。 通过从协作轨迹中建模出连续的合作行为潜在空间，这些方法能让目标策略接触到超出已观察群体范围的合作对象，并在《Overcooked》[ 4 ] 等完全可观测的环境中取得了显著成果。

paragraphs.en: In practical collaboration, however, limited sensing and the movement of agents rarely afford full observability over either the task state or the partner [ 34 , 35 ] . Under such partial observability (PO), coordination cues are confined to the ego agent’s observable region, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . The agent must coordinate with unseen partners from incomplete information about partner behavior and task state. Within ZSC, partial observability has been studied primarily in the informational sense exemplified by Hanabi [ 2 ] , where the hidden information is prescribed by the game rules. In such settings the partner’s actions remain visible, and what is concealed is a fixed set of variables. Embodied collaboration instead induces spatial and dynamic partial observability.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在实际协作中，感知能力的限制以及智能体的移动通常使得既无法完全观察任务状态，也无法完全观察到协作伙伴 [34, 35]。 在这种部分可观测性（PO）条件下，协调信号被限制在自我智能体能够观察到的区域内，如图 1 所示。 智能体必须基于对协作伙伴行为和任务状态的不完整信息，与无法直接观察到的伙伴进行协调。 在 ZSC 领域，部分可观测性主要是在 Hanabi [2] 所体现的信息学意义上被研究的，其中隐藏的信息由游戏规则预先规定。 在此类设定中，协作伙伴的行为仍然是可见的，而被隐藏的内容则是一组固定的变量。 相比之下，具身协作则会引发空间性和动态性的部分可观测性。

paragraphs.en: What the ego agent perceives changes over time with its restricted field of view and with the movement of both agents. The information asymmetry here is therefore induced by viewpoint. paragraphs.en: In this work, we study ZSC under dynamic and spatial partial observability. We identify two key challenges that arise when VAE-based generative ZSC is transferred to partially observable environments. First, partial observability degrades the partner diversity captured in the generator’s latent space. Because informative segments of the partner’s motion are occluded outside the field of view, the encoder receives distinct partner trajectories as similar local observations. Behavior patterns that are separable under richer observations thus collapse into overlapping latent regions, restricting the coverage of the modeled partner space. To address this, we introduce a Joint-view VAE. A teacher encoder receives the union of the two agents’ local observations, and its posterior is distilled into a student encoder that sees only the ego-centric observation. This preserves behaviorally meaningful variation under limited input and retains diversity in the generated partners. Here, the joint view denotes additional partial-view evidence available only during VAE training, not access to the unobservable global state. The resulting generator therefore remains deployment-compatible.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了动态且存在空间部分可观测性的 ZSC。 我们识别出两个关键挑战：当基于 VAE 的生成式 ZSC 被迁移到部分可观测环境时，这些问题便会显现。 首先，部分可观测性会降低生成器潜在空间中捕捉到的伙伴多样性。 由于伙伴运动的富信息片段在视野之外被遮挡，编码器会将不同的伙伴轨迹视为相似的局部观测。 因此，在更丰富的观测条件下本应可区分的行为模式会坍缩为重叠的潜在区域，从而限制了对伙伴空间建模的覆盖范围。 为解决这一问题，我们引入了一种联合视角 VAE。 一个教师编码器接收两个智能体的局部观测的并集，其后验分布会被蒸馏到一个仅能感知自我中心观测的学生编码器中。 这能在有限输入下保留行为上的有意义差异，并维持生成伙伴的多样性。 此处，联合视角指的是仅在 VAE 训练期间可用的额外部分视角证据，而非对不可观测的全局状态的访问权限。 因此，最终生成的生成器仍然具备部署兼容性。

paragraphs.en: Second, partial observability restricts the evidence on which the target policy bases its decisions. Once the partner leaves the ego agent’s observable region, essential information such as its current location, recent action, and intended subtask is lost [ 8 , 13 , 21 , 32 , 37 ] . Since coordination decisions depend heavily on where the partner is and what it will do next, the policy must infer hidden partner-related information from its own observation history. Inspired by belief-based modeling in partially observable reinforcement learning [ 17 , 19 , 52 ] , we introduce Partner-state Belief networks. A Location Belief estimates the position of the partner while it is out of view, and a Behavioral Belief predicts what the partner is likely to do. Together they allow the policy to compensate for uncertainty about the partner and to act in a belief-aware manner. Importantly, we follow a decentralized PO protocol during policy execution. Logged partner information is used only as auxiliary supervision for the belief networks at the PPO update stage, and is never provided as input to the policy. At deployment, the policy therefore acts solely from its own observations and its self-estimated beliefs.

paragraphs.en: Integrating these two components, we propose Predicting Intention of Partner (PIP), a framework for zero-shot coordination under dynamic and spatial partial observability. The Joint-view VAE improves the diversity of generated partners, and the Partner-state Belief enables belief-aware decision making. PIP thus jointly addresses partner generation and policy learning from incomplete observations. We evaluate PIP on Overcooked-PO, Burrito-PO, and Melting Pot [ 4 , 23 , 1 ] , benchmarks that combine dynamic cooperative tasks with spatial partial observability. PIP achieves strong coordination performance with both unseen partners and humans, and further analyses demonstrate that each component operates as intended and contributes to robust coordination. Our main contributions are as follows:

paragraphs.en: Zero-shot coordination requires agents to collaborate with previously unseen partners, including independently trained agents and humans [ 41 , 15 ] . Other-Play [ 15 ] and Any-Play [ 27 ] reduce reliance on arbitrary coordination conventions. CEC [ 18 ] promotes coordination between agents trained in different environments. Another major direction is population-based training, which exposes a target policy to diverse partners and conventions. Existing methods construct partner populations or explicitly optimize their diversity [ 43 , 50 , 38 , 28 ] . GAMMA [ 26 ] , TALENTS [ 23 ] , and GOAT [ 6 ] use generative latent spaces to produce diverse or challenging partners. E3T [ 48 ] avoids a pretrained population by constructing partners from mixtures of the ego and random policies while jointly learning partner action prediction. Collectively, these approaches improve generalization by exposing the target policy to diverse behaviors and coordination conventions during training.

paragraphs.en: PO-ZSC includes different settings depending on which information is unobserved and how it becomes unavailable. A representative line of work considers environments such as Hanabi [ 2 ] , where private or asymmetric information is defined by the game structure. In Hanabi, agents have access to different card information, and actions serve both task execution and communication. Prior studies combine compatibility with novel partners and belief-based inference of hidden information [ 15 , 28 , 8 , 31 ] . ERS [ 30 ] instead broadens the symmetry class to discourage incompatible conventions in Dec-POMDPs. These studies primarily address information asymmetry imposed by game rules. In spatial coordination environments, however, observability changes with agent positions and movements. OvercookedV2 [ 10 ] introduces restricted fields of view and asymmetric task information and evaluates existing ZSC methods under spatial partial observability. However, existing methods handle the resulting intermittent loss of partner observations only implicitly. To the best of our knowledge, prior work that jointly addresses incomplete partner representations and explicitly infers the positions and actions of currently unobserved partners remains limited.
paragraphs.zh: PO-ZSC 会根据哪些信息未被观察到以及这些信息如何变得不可用而采用不同的设置。 一个代表性的研究系列考虑了像 Hanabi [ 2 ] 这样的环境，其中私有或非对称信息由游戏结构所定义。 在 Hanabi 中，智能体可以访问不同的卡片信息，其行动既用于执行任务，也用于沟通。 先前的研究将与新伙伴的兼容性以及基于信念的隐藏信息推断相结合 [ 15 , 28 , 8 , 31 ] 。 相比之下，ERS [ 30 ] 扩展了对称性类别，以避免 Dec-POMDP 中不兼容的惯例。 这些研究主要关注由游戏规则造成的信息不对称问题。 然而，在空间协调环境中，可观察性会随着智能体的位置和移动而发生变化。 OvercookedV2 [ 10 ] 引入了受限的视野和非对称的任务信息，并评估了现有 ZSC 方法在空间部分可观察性下的表现。 然而，现有方法仅以隐式方式处理由此导致的对伙伴观察的间歇性丢失问题。 据我们所知，目前尚无大量研究能同时解决不完整的伙伴表示问题，并显式推断当前未被观察到的伙伴的位置和行动。

paragraphs.en: Recent generative latent-variable approaches to ZSC [ 26 , 6 ] represent a cooperation strategy as a latent variable z ∈ 𝒵 z\in\mathcal{Z} in a continuous latent space. These methods first collect partner trajectory data, such as trajectories generated by MEP [ 50 ] -trained policies. They then learn a generative representation of partner behaviors to model diverse coordination strategies. Let τ = ( o 0 p , a 0 p , … , o T p , a T p ) \tau=(o^{p}_{0},a^{p}_{0},\dots,o^{p}_{T},a^{p}_{T}) denote a trajectory generated by a partner policy, and let h t p = ( o 0 p , a 0 p , … , o t p ) h^{p}_{t}=(o^{p}_{0},a^{p}_{0},\dots,o^{p}_{t}) be the partner’s history up to time t t . An encoder q ϕ ​ ( z ∣ τ ) q_{\phi}(z\mid\tau) maps the trajectory to a posterior over latent strategies, where z z captures high-level behavioral factors such as convention, preference, or execution style. paragraphs.en: We follow the centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) paradigm for multi-agent reinforcement learning. To consider a more realistic partial observability setting, the policy is trained from PO rollouts collected by the agents, without using unobserved global state as policy input. During PPO training, logged partner-state information from these rollouts is used only as auxiliary supervision for the belief heads, and is not provided to the actor as input or used during execution. Thus, throughout decentralized execution, the policy is conditioned only on the agent’s own ego-centric observation history.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循多智能体强化学习中的集中训练、分散执行（CTDE）范式。 为了考虑更真实的部分可观测性设定，策略是通过智能体收集的部分可观测（PO）轨迹进行训练的，而不会将未观测到的全局状态作为策略输入。 在 PPO 训练过程中，这些轨迹中记录的合作者状态信息仅用作信念头的辅助监督信号，并不会作为输入提供给执行器，也不会在执行阶段使用。 因此，在整个分散执行过程中，策略仅基于智能体自身的以自我为中心的观测历史进行条件判断。

paragraphs.en: Although the Joint-view VAE improves the generative partner model, it alone does not resolve the target agent’s decision-making problem under partial observability. At deployment, the agent must select ego actions from its ego-centric history, where the partner’s current location, intention, and action tendency may be hidden. While the recurrent actor can implicitly summarize the interaction history, we use a separately supervised belief state to explicitly retain partner-related information that may become unavailable in the current observation. We therefore augment the target policy with a Partner-state Belief module updated from the agent’s local observation history during execution.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管联合视角 VAE 改进了生成性伙伴模型，但它单独无法解决目标智能体在部分可观测性条件下的决策问题。 在部署时，智能体必须从其以自我为中心的历史记录中选择自身行动，而伙伴的当前位置、意图和行动倾向可能处于隐藏状态。 虽然循环执行器可以隐式地总结交互历史，但我们使用一个独立监督的信念状态模块，显式保留可能在当前观察中无法获取的与伙伴相关的信息。 因此，我们在目标策略中增加了一个伙伴状态信念模块，该模块在执行期间根据智能体的局部观察历史进行更新。

sents.en: Although the Joint-view VAE improves the generative partner model, it alone does not resolve the target agent’s decision-making problem under partial observability.

sents.en: At deployment, the agent must select ego actions from its ego-centric history, where the partner’s current location, intention, and action tendency may be hidden.
sents.zh: 在部署时，智能体必须从其以自我为中心的历史记录中选择自身行动，而伙伴的当前位置、意图和行动倾向可能处于隐藏状态。

sents.en: While the recurrent actor can implicitly summarize the interaction history, we use a separately supervised belief state to explicitly retain partner-related information that may become unavailable in the current observation.
sents.zh: 虽然循环执行器可以隐式地总结交互历史，但我们使用一个独立监督的信念状态模块，显式保留可能在当前观察中无法获取的与伙伴相关的信息。

sents.en: We therefore augment the target policy with a Partner-state Belief module updated from the agent’s local observation history during execution.
sents.zh: 因此，我们在目标策略中增加了一个伙伴状态信念模块，该模块在执行期间根据智能体的局部观察历史进行更新。

paragraphs.en: Burrito-PO is our primary benchmark for zero-shot coordination under ego-centric partial observability. It adapts the cooperative Burrito environment [ 23 ] by restricting each agent to a 7 × 7 7\times 7 window centered on itself and masking cells outside this window. We consider four layouts, Open, Hallway, Forced-Coord (FC), and Ring. Following prior work [ 45 , 23 ] , we construct 24 candidate partners per layout and select 12 behaviorally diverse partners for evaluation. For each layout, every selected partner is evaluated over 10 episodes. We report mean performance and standard error.
paragraphs.zh: Burrito-PO 是我们用于测试以自我为中心的部分可观测性条件下零样本协作的主要基准。 它通过限制每个智能体只能看到以自己为中心的 7×7 窗口，并遮蔽该窗口外的单元格，对协作性 Burrito 环境 [23] 进行了调整。 我们考虑了四种布局：Open、Hallway、Forced-Coord (FC) 和 Ring。 遵循先前的研究 [45, 23]，我们为每种布局构建了 24 个候选伙伴，并从中挑选出行为多样化的 12 个伙伴进行评估。 对于每种布局，每个选定的伙伴都会在 10 轮实验中接受评估。 我们报告了平均表现和标准误差。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports ZSC performance against held-out partners under partial observability. PIP achieves the best performance across all four layouts. The relative improvement is particularly large on Ring, where the movable region forms a narrow loop-like route. The partner’s future movement is strongly constrained by this structure, allowing the belief module to anticipate the partner’s hidden position and movement direction more reliably from local observations. This result suggests that Partner-state Belief is particularly beneficial when the partner is frequently outside the ego agent’s field of view and the policy must infer hidden partner states to anticipate coordination opportunities.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 报告了在部分可观测性条件下，ZSC 与预留伙伴的性能表现。 PIP 在所有四种布局中均实现了最佳性能。 在环形布局中，相对提升尤为显著，因为可移动区域形成了一个狭窄的环状路径。 这种结构强烈约束了伙伴的未来移动，使得信念模块能够基于局部观测更可靠地预测伙伴的隐藏位置和移动方向。 这一结果表明，当伙伴经常处于自我智能体视野之外，且策略必须推断伙伴的隐藏状态以预测协作机会时，伙伴状态信念尤其有益。

paragraphs.en: We recruit 66 participants and ask each participant to interact with three anonymized partner agents corresponding to GAMMA, GOAT, and PIP in Burrito-PO. paragraphs.en: We conduct an ablation study to isolate the contribution of each component in our framework, as summarized in Sec. 5.2 . Row (a) corresponds to the GAMMA baseline, whose VAE is trained only on partial-observation trajectories. Comparing rows (a) and (b), replacing this VAE with our student VAE distilled from the joint-view teacher VAE improves performance, suggesting that distillation mitigates representation degradation under partial observability and provides more useful latent partner representations for generated-partner training. A similar improvement is observed from rows (e) to (f), further supporting the benefit of the distilled VAE when Partner-state Belief is used.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了一项消融研究，以分离我们框架中每个组件的贡献，具体总结见第 5.2 节。 （a）行对应于 GAMMA 基线模型，其 VAE 仅在部分可观测轨迹上进行训练。 比较（a）行和（b）行，将这一 VAE 替换为我们从联合视角教师 VAE 中蒸馏出的学生 VAE 后，性能得到了提升。这表明蒸馏过程减轻了部分可观测性下的表示退化问题，并为生成的伙伴训练提供了更有用的潜在伙伴表示。 从（e）行到（f）行也观察到了类似的改进，这进一步证明了在使用“伙伴状态信念”时，蒸馏 VAE 所带来的益处。

paragraphs.en: We analyze how Partner-state Belief benefits coordination across different partner occlusion levels. This result shows that Partner-state Belief improves zero-shot coordination most when partner information cannot be obtained directly from the current observation. Additional analyses of Partner-state Belief are provided in the appendices .
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析了“伙伴状态信念”在不同程度的伙伴遮挡情况下如何促进协作。 我们将预留的 BP 策略按照其与 PIP 配对时，其伙伴处于自我智能体视野之外的时间比例进行排序，并将其分为四个大小相等的组别。 如图 6 所示，PIP 的表现始终优于将信念消息置零填充的缺陷策略。 在伙伴被遮挡频率最高的组别中，这种差距最大。 这一结果表明，“伙伴状态信念”在无法直接从当前观察中获得伙伴信息时，对零样本协作的提升最为显著。 关于“伙伴状态信念”的更多分析见附录。

paragraphs.en: We study generative ZSC under local-view partial observability and propose PIP, which combines a Joint-view VAE for deployment-compatible partner representations with Partner-state Belief networks for hidden-state inference. PIP achieves the highest mean performance across Burrito-PO, Overcooked-PO, and a Melting Pot substrate, with human evaluation and diagnostic analyses further supporting its design. These results demonstrate the importance of partner representations and belief-aware decision making for ZSC under spatially restricted observations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在局部视角的部分可观测性条件下研究生成式 ZSC，并提出了 PIP。该方法将用于部署兼容的伙伴表示的联合视角 VAE 与用于隐藏状态推理的伙伴状态信念网络相结合。 PIP 在 Burrito-PO、Overcooked-PO 和 Melting Pot 底板上均实现了最高的平均性能，人类评估和诊断分析也进一步验证了其设计的有效性。 这些结果表明，在空间受限的观察条件下，伙伴表示和具备信念感知的决策对于 ZSC 至关重要。

sents.en: We study generative ZSC under local-view partial observability and propose PIP, which combines a Joint-view VAE for deployment-compatible partner representations with Partner-state Belief networks for hidden-state inference.
sents.zh: 我们在局部视角的部分可观测性条件下研究生成式 ZSC，并提出了 PIP。该方法将用于部署兼容的伙伴表示的联合视角 VAE 与用于隐藏状态推理的伙伴状态信念网络相结合。

sents.en: These results demonstrate the importance of partner representations and belief-aware decision making for ZSC under spatially restricted observations.

paragraphs.en: Although the deployed policy uses only local observations, the belief module is trained with auxiliary supervision for future partner actions and partner positions. Such labels are available in simulated training environments but may be difficult or costly to obtain in real-world decentralized settings. Future work should therefore investigate weakly supervised or self-supervised belief learning methods that reduce reliance on explicit partner-state labels.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管部署的策略仅使用局部观察信息，但信念模块在训练时仍借助辅助监督来预测未来合作方的行动和位置。 这类标签在模拟训练环境中可以轻松获取，但在现实世界的去中心化场景中可能难以获得或成本高昂。 因此，未来的研究应探索弱监督或自监督的信念学习方法，以降低对明确合作方状态标签的依赖。

paragraphs.en: According to the ZSC-Eval [ 45 ] framework, a well-designed population of behavior preference (BP) agents, constructed with event-based reward functions, can provide behaviorally diverse partners for zero-shot coordination evaluation. Following this idea, we construct, for each domain, a candidate pool of held-out BP agents whose sole purpose is to supply diverse evaluation partners that are never seen during target policy training.
paragraphs.zh: 根据 ZSC-Eval [ 45 ] 框架，一个设计良好的行为偏好（BP）智能体群体，通过基于事件的奖励函数构建，可以为零样本协作评估提供行为多样化的伙伴。 遵循这一思路，我们为每个域构建了一个候选池，其中包含预留的 BP 智能体，其唯一目的是提供多样化的评估伙伴，这些伙伴在目标策略训练期间从未出现过。

paragraphs.en: We follow the partner construction protocol used in TALENTS [ 23 ] and define nine tunable behavior preferences, grouped into three categories of three binary preference dimensions each. Each dimension assigns either an encouraged (a positive weight) or a discouraged (a negative weight) preference to one behavior, and all remaining shaping terms are held fixed and shared across the pool. Enumerating all binary combinations within one category yields 2 3 = 8 2^{3}=8 agents, and the three categories together give 24 24 BP candidate agents per layout. The preference categories, shaping terms, and corresponding weights are summarized in Tab. B.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循 TALENTS [23] 中使用的合作伙伴构建协议，定义了九种可调的行为偏好，并将其分为三类，每类包含三个二元偏好维度。 每个维度为一种行为分配受鼓励（正权重）或受抑制（负权重）的偏好，而所有其余的塑形项则保持固定并在整个池中共享。 枚举某一类别内的所有二进制组合可得到 2^3 = 8 个智能体，三类组合在一起则为每种布局提供 24 个 BP 候选智能体。 偏好类别、塑形项及相应的权重总结于表 B.1。

paragraphs.en: Zero-shot coordination (ZSC) inherently requires agents to collaborate with a partner. When the partner is almost never observable, the task effectively degenerates into single-agent play, eliminating meaningful coordination signals. Conversely, when the partner is almost always visible, the setting becomes nearly indistinguishable from full observability. This makes it difficult to evaluate zero-shot coordination performance under partial observability. To determine an appropriate PO window size for Burrito-PO, we first empirically measured the partner-visibility ratio for different view sizes across all Burrito-PO layouts. Specifically, we performed self-play rollouts using SP agents trained in Stage 1 of MEP, running 5 episodes per policy (40 episodes per layout in total), and recorded partner visibility at each timestep for each view size. The results are summarized in Fig. C.1 . For view size K = 3 × 3 K=3\times 3 , the visibility ratio in the Forced-Coord (FC) layout is 0 % 0\% , making it overly restrictive as a coordination task. While K = 5 × 5 K=5\times 5 achieves moderate visibility in other layouts, it remains insufficient in FC to reliably evaluate PO-ZSC performance. In contrast, for K = 9 × 9 K=9\times 9 and K = 11 × 11 K=11\times 11 , visibility ratios are consistently high across all layouts. As a result, the distinction between full and partial observability becomes blurred, making it difficult to isolate zero-shot coordination performance under partial observability. Based on this analysis, we select K = 7 × 7 K=7\times 7 as the default window size for Burrito-PO, as it maintains a non-trivial level of visibility across all layouts while preserving sufficient occlusion. Under this setting, agents must meaningfully infer their partners while still receiving intermittent observations, forming an appropriate regime for evaluating ZSC under partial observability. We follow a similar procedure for the remaining benchmarks. This yields K = 5 × 5 K=5\times 5 for Overcooked-PO. For Melting Pot, we adopt the official egocentric view range (5 cells to each side, 1 cell behind, and 9 cells ahead of the agent, with each cell rendered at 8 × 8 8\times 8 pixels) which we found to satisfy the criterion above, exhibiting neither degenerate near-zero nor near-full partner visibility across substrates. We therefore keep it unchanged and use these settings throughout our experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 零样本协作（ZSC）本质上要求智能体与搭档进行合作。 当搭档几乎无法被观察到时，该任务实际上会退化为单智能体博弈，从而消除有意义的协作信号。 相反，当搭档几乎始终可见时，这种设定与完全可观察性几乎没有区别。 这使得在部分可观察条件下评估零样本协作性能变得困难。 为了确定 Burrito-PO 的合适 PO 窗口大小，我们首先通过实证测量了所有 Burrito-PO 布局中不同视野大小下的搭档可见性比率。 具体来说，我们使用在 MEP 第一阶段训练出的 SP 智能体进行了自我博弈推演，每个策略运行 5 轮（每个布局共 40 轮），并记录每个时间步和每种视野大小下搭档的可见性状态。 结果汇总于图 C.1。 对于 K = 3 × 3 的视野大小，在强制协作（FC）布局中的可见性比率为 0%，使其作为协作任务过于受限。 虽然 K = 5 × 5 在其他布局中实现了中等水平的可见性，但在 FC 布局中仍不足以可靠地评估 PO-ZSC 性能。 相比之下，对于 K = 9 × 9 和 K = 11 × 11，所有布局中的可见性比率都保持一致的高水平。 因此，完全可观察性与部分可观察性之间的界限变得模糊，难以单独评估部分可观察条件下的零样本协作性能。 基于此分析，我们选择 K = 7 × 7 作为 Burrito-PO 的默认窗口大小，因为它在所有布局中都能维持非平凡的可见性水平，同时保留足够的遮挡效果。 在此设定下，智能体必须对搭档进行有意义的推断，同时仍需接收间歇性的观察信息，从而形成评估部分可观察条件下 ZSC 的合适环境。 我们对其余基准测试也遵循类似流程。 由此得出 Overcooked-PO 的 K = 5 × 5。 对于 Melting Pot，我们采用官方的自我中心视野范围（智能体两侧各 5 格、后方 1 格、前方 9 格，每格以 8 × 8 像素渲染），我们发现该设定满足上述标准，在不同子环境中既不会出现接近于零的退化可见性，也不会出现接近完全的可见性。 因此，我们保持该设定不变，并在整个实验中沿用这些参数。

paragraphs.en: FCP [ 43 ] builds a frozen partner pool by collecting init / mid / final checkpoints from several self-play seeds, and trains a best-response (BR) ego policy by uniformly sampling partners from this pool. Our only strict-PO modification is the observation regime. The original method was evaluated under full observability, whereas in our setting both the Stage 1 self-play training (8 seeds) and the Stage 2 BR training are run with ego-centric partial observations using view radius 3, corresponding to a 7 × 7 7\times 7 local observation window. paragraphs.en: E3T [ 48 ] avoids any external partner pool by setting the partner side to a mixture of an ego self-copy and a random policy, π p = ϵ ​ π r + ( 1 − ϵ ) ​ π e \pi_{p}=\epsilon\,\pi_{r}+(1-\epsilon)\,\pi_{e} , and jointly trains, end-to-end, a context encoder consuming a length- k k history of (state, partner-action) pairs together with a head that predicts the partner’s next action distribution; the ego policy is conditioned on the current state and the predicted partner action distribution and trained by PPO. Our strict-PO setting introduces two modifications. First, every state input on both the encoder side and the ego-policy side is replaced with the ego’s partial observation, so that no module ever sees the environment state directly. paragraphs.en: GAMMA [ 26 ] pretrains a conditional VAE that generates partner behaviors, and trains the cooperator with PPO by sampling a fresh latent z ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I ) z\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I) at the start of each episode and rolling out against the decoder conditioned on z z . Our strict-PO setting introduces two modifications. First, while the original VAE encoder consumes full joint trajectories τ \tau and the decoder relies on simulator-side state information, our VAE is retrained so that both the encoder and the decoder take only the partner’s PO as input; the partner generator is therefore closed under partial observability, and the partner behaviors produced by the decoder remain within the action distribution of strict-PO policies. Second, although the original work places no explicit restriction on the cooperator’s critic, we disable the centralized value function, so that both the actor and the critic of the cooperator operate solely on its own PO, i.e. in IPPO mode. The remaining structure (per-episode z z sampling, BR training of the cooperator against the z z -conditioned partner via PPO) is identical to the original.
paragraphs.zh: GAMMA [ 26 ] 首先预训练一个条件 VAE，用于生成合作者的行为；然后通过 PPO 训练合作者：在每个回合开始时采样一个新的潜在变量 z ∼ 𝒩(0,I)，并基于以 z 为条件的解码器进行 rollout。 我们的严格-PO 设置引入了两项修改。 首先，原始 VAE 编码器会接收完整的联合轨迹 τ，而解码器则依赖模拟器侧的状态信息；我们的 VAE 经过重新训练，使得编码器和解码器都仅以合作者的 PO 作为输入。因此，在部分可观测性条件下，合作者生成器是封闭的，且解码器生成的合作者行为仍保持在严格-PO 策略的动作分布范围内。 其次，尽管原始研究未对合作者的批评者施加任何明确限制，但我们禁用了集中式价值函数，使得合作者的行动者和批评者都仅基于其自身的 PO 运行，即处于 IPPO 模式。 其余结构（每回合采样 z、通过 PPO 训练合作者以对抗以 z 为条件的合作者）与原始研究完全相同。

paragraphs.en: GOAT [ 6 ] reuses the same frozen VAE decoder as a partner generator but replaces the fixed prior z ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I ) z\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I) with an adversary policy π A \pi_{A} that maps z ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I ) → z ′ = π A ​ ( z ) z\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I)\to z^{\prime}=\pi_{A}(z) so as to maximize the regret Regret ⁡ ( π P , π C ) = 𝔼 ⁡ [ V ⁡ ( π P , π P ) − V ⁡ ( π P , π C ) ] = J SP − J XP \mathrm{Regret}(\pi_{P},\pi_{C})=\mathbb{E}\!\left[V(\pi_{P},\pi_{P})-V(\pi_{P},\pi_{C})\right]=J_{\text{SP}}-J_{\text{XP}} . Each episode therefore consists of a two-phase rollout, a partner-vs-partner self-play rollout that estimates J SP J_{\text{SP}} and a partner-vs-cooperator cross-play rollout that estimates J XP J_{\text{XP}} , with the cooperator and the adversary forming the two sides of a minimax game. Our strict-PO setting inherits the two GAMMA modifications and adds nothing else: the partner-generator VAE is trained to consume only the partner’s partial observation, and the cooperator is trained as IPPO. Since the adversary π A \pi_{A} operates purely on the latent z z and never receives any observation as input, it does not introduce any new PO-violating surface; the two-phase rollout structure and the regret objective are kept exactly as in the original method.

sents.en: Each episode therefore consists of a two-phase rollout, a partner-vs-partner self-play rollout that estimates J SP J_{\text{SP}} and a partner-vs-cooperator cross-play rollout that estimates J XP J_{\text{XP}} , with the cooperator and the adversary forming the two sides of a minimax game.

sents.en: Our strict-PO setting inherits the two GAMMA modifications and adds nothing else: the partner-generator VAE is trained to consume only the partner’s partial observation, and the cooperator is trained as IPPO.

sents.en: Since the adversary π A \pi_{A} operates purely on the latent z z and never receives any observation as input, it does not introduce any new PO-violating surface; the two-phase rollout structure and the regret objective are kept exactly as in the original method.
sents.zh: 由于对抗策略 π A \pi_{A} 完全基于潜在变量 z z 运行，且从未接收任何观测信息作为输入，因此它不会引入任何新的违反 PO 的表面结构；两阶段展开结构和遗憾目标均与原始方法完全一致。

paragraphs.en: For the generative partner model, we train the Joint-view VAE in two stages. In the first stage, the teacher VAE is trained using a richer partial-view input constructed from the union of both agents’ partial observations and the partner-side observation. In the second stage, the teacher is frozen and the student VAE is trained from the partner-side partial observation with an additional posterior distillation loss. We use KL ⁡ ( q T | q S ) \mathrm{KL}(q_{T}|q_{S}) rather than the reverse direction so that the student posterior covers all modes of the more informative teacher posterior, preserving the diversity that the teacher captures from the joint view. Both stages share the same backbone architecture, optimizer settings, latent dimension, and KL annealing schedule. The VAE hyperparameters are provided in Tab. C.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于生成式合作伙伴模型，我们以两个阶段训练联合视角 VAE。 在第一阶段，教师 VAE 使用更丰富的部分视角输入进行训练，该输入由两个智能体的部分观测结果与伴侣侧的观测结果的并集构成。 在第二阶段，教师模型被冻结，学生 VAE 则基于伴侣侧的部分观测结果，并结合额外的后验蒸馏损失进行训练。 我们使用 KL⁡(q_T|q_S) \mathrm{KL}(q_{T}|q_{S}) 而非反向形式，以确保学生模型的后验分布能够覆盖信息更丰富的教师模型后验分布的所有模式，从而保留教师模型从联合视角中捕捉到的多样性。 两个阶段共享相同的骨干架构、优化器设置、潜在维度以及 KL 退火计划。 VAE 的超参数见表 C.4。

paragraphs.en: We report representative computational costs in Tab. C.3 , measured at the training rollout batch size of 64. Compared with the baseline average of GAMMA and GOAT, our method increases total parameters from 463K to 591K, with the additional parameters concentrated in the actor while the critic size remains unchanged. Actor rollout inference time increases from 1.13 ms to 2.05 ms, and actor rollout computation increases from 0.381G to 0.764G FLOPs. This corresponds to an actor rollout inference rate of roughly 500 Hz at this batch size, suggesting that the inference overhead is unlikely to preclude real-time execution in this setting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在表 C.3 中报告了具有代表性的计算成本，这些成本是在训练展开批大小为 64 时测量的。与 GAMMA 和 GOAT 的基线平均值相比，我们的方法将总参数从 463K 增加到了 591K，其中额外参数集中在智能体执行器中，而智能体评论家的规模保持不变。智能体执行器的展开推理时间从 1.13 ms 增加到 2.05 ms，展开计算量则从 0.381G 增加到 0.764G FLOPs。在此批大小下，这相当于智能体执行器的展开推理速率约为 500 Hz，表明推理开销不太可能在此设置中阻碍实时执行。

paragraphs.en: Forced-Coord (FC) consists of two narrow vertical workspaces separated by central obstacles and counters. Each agent has access to different nearby task objects, and the usable movement paths are constrained by narrow passages. This layout explicitly enforces spatial separation between agents, making the full recipe infeasible for a single agent under the same task constraints. Therefore, we do not report a single-play shortest-path completion step count for this layout. The layout instead emphasizes role division and handoff-style coordination, while the spatial separation makes it difficult for one agent to continuously observe the other.
paragraphs.zh: 强制协调（FC）布局包含两个狭窄的垂直工作区，中间由障碍物和柜台隔开。 每个智能体都能接触到附近不同的任务对象，而可用的移动路径则受到狭窄通道的限制。 这种布局明确地强制智能体之间保持空间分离，因此在相同任务约束下，单个智能体无法完成整个流程。 因此，我们未针对此布局报告单次博弈中的最短路径完成步数。 相反，该布局强调角色分工和接力式协调，而空间上的分离则使得一个智能体难以持续观察到另一个智能体。

paragraphs.en: The single-play shortest-path completion steps further quantify the structural differences among the layouts where a solo completion path is feasible. Open requires 137 steps, Ring requires 156 steps, and Hallway requires 172 steps to complete the recipe under a shortest-path solo planner. This increase reflects that the layouts require progressively longer navigation paths, more distributed object access, and more complex task execution even before multi-agent coordination is considered. paragraphs.en: We evaluate on the counter_circuit layout, a 5 × 9 5\times 9 ring shaped kitchen whose central counter block leaves only a one tile wide circular corridor. paragraphs.en: In coop_mining , iron ore can be mined individually for a reward of + 1 +1 , whereas gold ore yields + 8 +8 to each agent only when both agents mine the same ore within a three step window. Obtaining the high value reward therefore requires successful rendezvous with a partner who is typically outside the agent’s egocentric field of view. Our pipeline trains an MEP partner population, a partner generating VAE, a KD teacher student VAE, and finally the target policy. Each stage requires hundreds of millions of environment steps. For our method, training on the original 27 × 27 27\times 27 map (global map size 216 × 216 216\times 216 ) results in out-of-memory errors on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU, making the computational and memory requirements prohibitively expensive. We therefore train all stages on a reduced 16 × 16 16\times 16 variant, coop_mining_small , with a global map size of 128 × 128 128\times 128 , which preserves the original dynamics and reward rules. Since the policy input remains a fixed 88 × 88 × 3 88\times 88\times 3 egocentric RGB observation and the action space is identical across map sizes, the learned policies transfer without modification. We evaluate them in a zero shot manner on the original 27 × 27 27\times 27 coop_mining map against the official Melting Pot bots, cooperator, defector, and mixed.

paragraphs.en: Our environment selection preserves comparability with existing partner-based evaluations while testing whether PIP transfers across partially observable settings. Burrito-PO retains the Burrito task and partner protocol, whereas Overcooked-PO follows the partner-based evaluation structures used in GAMMA and GOAT while modifying the observation condition. This design limits confounding changes in task mechanics and partner construction, allowing the effect of intermittent partner visibility to be examined more directly. Burrito-PO provides the primary setting for partner-state inference, while Overcooked-PO tests whether the same approach remains effective under a different task structure and held-out-partner protocol. In both environments, explicit predictions of unobserved partner locations and actions allow us to assess partner-state inference accuracy alongside coordination performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的环境选择在与现有基于搭档的评估保持可比性的同时，检验了 PIP 在部分可观察设置中的迁移能力。 Burrito-PO 保留了 Burrito 任务和搭档协议，而 Overcooked-PO 则遵循 GAMMA 和 GOAT 中使用的基于搭档的评估结构，同时对观察条件进行了修改。 这种设计限制了任务机制和搭档构建方面的干扰性变化，从而能够更直接地检验间歇性搭档可见性的影响。 Burrito-PO 提供了用于推断搭档状态的主要环境，而 Overcooked-PO 则测试了相同方法在不同任务结构和保留搭档协议下的有效性。 在这两种环境中，对未观察到的搭档位置和行动的明确预测使我们能够同时评估搭档状态推断的准确性与协作表现。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. F.1 , the fixed- σ \sigma baseline produces a broad latent region with heavily intermixed partner identities. paragraphs.en: We first evaluate the Location Belief. Since exact cell-level localization under partial observability is unnecessarily strict, the model predicts a coarse location bin, where each bin corresponds to a 2 × 2 2\times 2 region of the map. In panel (a) of Fig. F.2 , we measure current coarse location prediction accuracy when the partner is outside the ego agent’s field of view, grouped by Time Since Last Seen (TSLS), the number of steps since the partner left the visible range. To focus on practically meaningful cases, we evaluate prediction when the partner is moving. The proposed Location Belief consistently outperforms statistical baselines, including (i) probability spreading over time-dependent reachable regions (Reachable probability), (ii) movement-direction-based extrapolation (Dead-reckoning), (iii) empirical action statistics from the data (Empirical statistics), and (iv) random selection from the reachable region (Walkable random). The gap is especially clear in the small-TSLS region, where the partner has just disappeared from view. This indicates that our model forms an informative belief about the likely region of the currently invisible partner, rather than relying only on simple reachability statistics. Moreover, panel (b) shows that the model predicts the partner’s Δ \Delta -step future location more accurately than the baselines, suggesting that the Location Belief captures both current hidden location and near-future movement.

paragraphs.en: We next evaluate the Behavioral Belief, which consists of two temporal components: the reactive belief for near-future behavior and the tendency belief for broader action tendency. paragraphs.en: To assess how closely our partial observability training pipeline approaches the performance attainable under full observability, we conduct a controlled experiment in which the entire pipeline is instead trained in a fully observable setting. Comparing the resulting performance with that of our proposed method allows us to quantify the performance gap caused by partial observability and evaluate how effectively our approach mitigates it. Specifically, partner dataset collection, VAE training, and target policy training are all performed under full observability. During evaluation, the fully observable-trained target policy acts with full observations, while the held-out BP partners receive only partial observations, identical to those used in the main experiments. We deliberately evaluate against the same held-out BP partners as in the main partial observability experiments, since BP agents differ substantially in task proficiency depending on their behavior preference. Reusing the identical evaluation partners eliminates partner-specific performance differences as a confounding factor, allowing the comparison to isolate the effect of the full-observability setting. The results are summarized in Table F.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估我们的部分可观测性训练流程在多大程度上接近完全可观测性条件下可达到的性能，我们进行了一项受控实验，在该实验中，整个流程改为在完全可观测的设置下进行训练。 将由此获得的性能与我们所提出方法的性能进行比较，使我们能够量化由部分可观测性引起的性能差距，并评估我们的方法在缓解这一差距方面的有效性。 具体而言，合作伙伴数据集的收集、VAE 训练以及目标策略训练均在完全可观测的条件下进行。 在评估过程中，经过完全可观测性训练的的目标策略使用完整观察信息进行行动，而被保留的 BP 合作伙伴仅接收部分观察信息，与主实验中使用的信息完全相同。 我们特意选择与主部分可观测性实验中相同的被保留 BP 合作伙伴进行比较，因为 BP 智能体因其行为偏好不同，在任务能力上存在显著差异。 重复使用相同的评估合作伙伴可以消除合作伙伴特定的性能差异这一干扰因素，从而使比较能够专注于完全可观测设置所带来的影响。 结果汇总于表 F.1 中。

paragraphs.en: Two distinct factors are involved in this experiment: the information available to the coordinator itself, and the behavior distribution of the partners it is trained with. Regarding the former, the Open layout is the least occluded of the four maps, so the information removed by the PO setting is comparatively limited. This may partially account for the small difference observed for our method. The latter factor, however, operates independently of how often the coordinator sees its partner. Partners acting under partial observability may search or wait when uncertain about the other agent, and thus follow a behavior distribution that differs from that of fully observable partners. An FO-trained coordinator is never exposed to such behaviors during training, so pairing it with PO evaluation partners introduces a partner-side distribution shift even when the coordinator’s own observations are complete. We hypothesize that GOAT’s pronounced degradation primarily reflects this shift, while identifying why the adversarially trained generator is particularly sensitive to it is left for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 本实验涉及两个不同的因素：协调器自身可获得的信息，以及其训练过程中所合作伙伴的行为分布。 就前者而言，Open 布局是四张地图中遮挡最少的，因此 PO 设置所移除的信息相对有限。 这或许部分解释了我们的方法所观察到的差异较小的原因。 然而，后者与协调器看到其合作伙伴的频率无关。 在部分可观测性条件下行动的合作伙伴，当对另一个智能体不确定时可能会搜索或等待，因此其行为分布会与完全可观测的合作伙伴不同。 使用 FO 训练的协调器在训练过程中从未接触过此类行为，因此将其与 PO 评估伙伴配对，即使协调器自身的观察是完整的，也会引入来自伙伴一方的分布偏移。 我们假设 GOAT 性能显著下降主要反映了这种偏移，而探究对抗性训练的生成器为何对此特别敏感，则留待未来研究。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether increased policy capacity or simple auxiliary partner-state prediction can reproduce PIP’s gains, we construct three controls based on GAMMA. The capacity control enlarges GAMMA’s policy GRU to approximately match PIP’s trainable parameter count. The supervision control attaches cross-entropy heads to GAMMA’s shared policy representation to predict future coarse partner locations and the partner’s current action. The joint control combines both modifications. Unlike these controls, PIP uses dedicated belief modules that predict future locations and discounted future-action distributions and conditions the policy on their representations. Because their action targets differ, the supervision controls do not exactly match PIP’s belief supervision. Results are reported in Tab. F.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估策略容量提升或简单的辅助伙伴状态预测能否重现 PIP 的增益，我们基于 GAMMA 构建了三种对照模型。 容量对照模型扩大了 GAMMA 的策略 GRU，使其可训练参数数量大致与 PIP 相当。 监督对照模型在 GAMMA 的共享策略表示上附加了交叉熵头，用于预测未来粗略的伙伴位置以及伙伴的当前动作。 联合对照模型结合了上述两种修改方式。 与这些对照模型不同，PIP 使用了专门的信念模块，该模块可预测未来位置和折扣后的未来动作分布，并以这些表示作为策略的条件输入。 由于它们的动作目标不同，监督对照模型并未完全匹配 PIP 的信念监督机制。 结果报告见表 F.2。

paragraphs.en: None of the evaluated controls reproduces PIP’s performance. The capacity control achieves a lower mean reward than GAMMA, while the supervision and joint controls achieve substantially lower mean rewards. These results indicate that approximately matching PIP’s parameter count or adding the evaluated partner-state prediction heads to GAMMA is insufficient to account for PIP’s gain under this setting.

paragraphs.en: We test how our method handles degraded observations by evaluating the converged PIP coordinator without further training in Burrito-PO Open layout. At test time, we corrupt its observation using one of two stochastic processes. The sparse process is a blackout in which the entire observation is masked with probability r r at each timestep, modelling intermittent sensor loss. The noisy process is a per-channel shuffle in which each observation channel is independently corrupted with probability r r , and the values of each corrupted channel are spatially permuted within the field of view. This preserves the per-channel value distribution while destroying spatial correspondence, modelling per-modality scrambling. Thus, r r denotes the probability of masking an entire observation under sparse blackout and the independent probability of shuffling each channel under noisy corruption. We sweep r r from 0 0 to 0.2 0.2 and report the mean return against the held-out pool of M = 12 M{=}12 partners (Mean ± \pm S.E.; Fig. F.3 ). PIP degrades gradually under both corruption processes. At r = 0.2 r{=}0.2 , the entire observation is masked at 20 % 20\% of timesteps under sparse blackout, whereas 20 % 20\% of observation channels are shuffled on average under noisy corruption. PIP retains returns of 207.1 207.1 and 187.8 187.8 under these respective conditions. Across the full range of r r , PIP remains above GAMMA under the uncorrupted observation condition ( 163.3 ± 10.6 163.3\pm 10.6 , dashed line), showing that its performance advantage persists under substantial test-time observation corruption.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过评估在 Burrito-PO Open 布局中无需进一步训练即可收敛的 PIP 协调器，来测试我们的方法如何处理退化的观测数据。 在测试阶段，我们使用两种随机过程之一来破坏其观测数据。 稀疏过程是一种“黑屏”机制：在每个时间步，整个观测数据以概率 r r 被掩码，模拟传感器间歇性丢失的情况。 噪声过程是一种逐通道打乱机制：每个观测通道以独立概率 r r 被破坏，且每个被破坏通道的数值会在视野范围内进行空间置换。 这种方式保留了各通道的数值分布，但破坏了空间对应关系，从而模拟了各模态数据的打乱现象。 因此，r r 表示在稀疏“黑屏”条件下掩码整个观测数据的概率，以及在噪声破坏条件下独立打乱每个通道的概率。 我们将 r r 从 0 0 到 0.2 0.2 逐步变化，并报告与预留的 M = 12 M{=}12 个伙伴池相比的平均回报（均值 ± \pm 标准误；图 F.3）。 在两种破坏过程下，PIP 的性能均会逐渐下降。 当 r = 0.2 r{=}0.2 时，在稀疏“黑屏”条件下，20 % 20\% 的时间步中整个观测数据都会被掩码；而在噪声破坏条件下，平均有 20 % 20\% 的观测通道会被打乱。 在这些各自条件下，PIP 的回报仍分别为 207.1 和 187.8。 在整个 r r 变化范围内，在未受破坏的观测条件下，PIP 的性能始终高于 GAMMA（163.3 ± 10.6，虚线），这表明其性能优势在测试阶段面临严重的观测数据破坏时依然存在。

paragraphs.en: As mentioned in the main paper, we voluntarily recruited participants for the experiment and provided them with sufficient time to understand the study procedure, potential risks, and data collection policy before obtaining their consent. As shown in Fig. G.1 , the consent form described the purpose of the human-AI coordination study, the overall experimental procedure, the types of anonymous data collected, and the purpose of data collection. The form also clarified that no personal identifiers, IP addresses, device information, location information, or other tracking identifiers were collected. To minimize privacy risks, each participant was assigned a random anonymous ID, and all collected data were used only for statistical analysis and research reporting. The study involved no physical or psychological risks beyond ordinary computer use, and participants were informed that their participation was voluntary and that they could withdraw from the study at any time.
paragraphs.zh: 如主论文所述，我们自愿招募了实验参与者，并在获得其同意之前，给予了他们充足的时间来了解研究流程、潜在风险和数据收集政策。如图 G.1 所示，同意书中说明了人类与人工智能协同研究的宗旨、整体实验流程、所收集的匿名数据类型以及数据收集的目的。该文件还明确说明，未收集任何个人身份标识、IP 地址、设备信息、位置信息或其他追踪标识。为最大限度地降低隐私风险，我们为每位参与者分配了一个随机的匿名 ID，且所有收集的数据仅用于统计分析和研究报告。本研究除常规计算机使用外，不涉及任何身体或心理风险，并告知参与者其参与是自愿的，且可随时退出研究。

paragraphs.en: Before the main user study, participants completed an interactive tutorial to familiarize themselves with the game rules, controls, object interactions, and burrito-making procedure. As shown in the left panel of Fig. G.2 , the tutorial interface displayed the current step, task instruction, relevant object icon, and a yellow “Continue” button. Participants advanced each step by clicking the button or pressing Enter, and the game timer was paused while instructions were displayed to avoid time pressure during reading. The tutorial guided participants through the essential gameplay mechanics, including movement, order-card interpretation, ingredient collection, chopping, cooking, plating, serving, fire handling, disposal of burned food, and dish washing, as summarized in Tab. G.1 . After completing the guided steps, participants were given a 60-second free-play period to further practice the controls and gameplay loop before the main survey, helping ensure a fairer comparison across AI partners.
paragraphs.zh: 在主用户研究开始前，参与者完成了一个互动教程，以熟悉游戏规则、控制方式、物体交互以及制作卷饼的流程。 如图 G.2 左侧面板所示， 教程界面显示了当前步骤、任务说明、相关物体图标以及一个黄色的“继续”按钮。 参与者通过点击按钮或按下回车键来推进每个步骤，并且在显示说明时游戏计时器会暂停，以避免阅读过程中受到时间压力。 该教程引导参与者了解核心的游戏机制，包括移动、解读订单卡、收集食材、切配、烹饪、装盘、上菜、处理火焰、丢弃烧焦的食物以及洗碗，相关内容总结于表 G.1。 完成引导步骤后，参与者在主调查开始前获得了 60 秒的自由游戏时间，以便进一步练习控制方式和游戏流程循环，从而有助于在不同 AI 伙伴之间实现更公平的比较。

paragraphs.en: After the tutorial, participants played the main survey episodes with AI partners using the gameplay interface shown in the right panel of Fig. G.2 . Each participant interacted with three different AI policies, GAMMA, GOAT, and PIP (Ours), in a randomized order, and played one 120-second (1200-timestep) episode with each policy. The interface displayed the anonymous participant ID, episode information, assigned AI partner, participant role and color, current score, remaining time, active order cards, plate count, and environment tick. The actual policy identity corresponding to the assigned AI partner, i.e. , whether it was GAMMA, GOAT, or PIP (Ours), was not revealed to participants during gameplay. The survey gameplay followed an ego-centric partial-observation setting: participants could observe only a limited region centered on their own character, while areas outside the visible region were masked in black and updated as the participant moved. Thus, participants evaluated each anonymized AI partner under incomplete information about both the partner and the full task state.
paragraphs.zh: 教程结束后，参与者通过图 G.2 右侧面板所示的游戏界面，与人工智能伙伴一起完成了主要调查关卡。 每位参与者都以随机顺序与三种不同的智能体策略——GAMMA、GOAT 和 PIP（我们的策略）进行互动，并与每种策略各完成一个时长 120 秒（即 1200 个时间步）的关卡。 该界面显示了参与者的匿名 ID、关卡信息、分配的人工智能伙伴、参与者的角色与颜色、当前得分、剩余时间、可用顺序卡、餐盘数量以及环境计时。 在遊戲過程中，並未向參與者透露所分配人工智能伙伴實際對應的策略身份，即其具體是 GAMMA、GOAT 還是 PIP（我們的策略）。 調查遊戲採用了以自我為中心的局部觀察設定：參與者只能觀察以自己角色為中心的一小片區域，而視界之外的區域則被黑色遮罩覆蓋，並隨參與者的移動而更新。 因此，參與者在對每個匿名人工智能伙伴進行評估時，既缺乏對該伙伴的完整資訊，也無法了解任務的全局狀態。

paragraphs.en: Table G.2 summarizes task-level sparse reward and final preference ranking. PIP achieves the highest sparse reward among the three agents, with a mean reward of 476.0 compared with 355.7 for GAMMA and 370.4 for GOAT. This corresponds to a 33.8% improvement over GAMMA and a 28.5% improvement over GOAT. paragraphs.en: Because each participant evaluated all three agents, we use within-subject nonparametric tests and report p-values rather than relying on the visual overlap of standard-error bars. The significance markers shown in panel (a) of the human-evaluation figure in the main paper correspond to the paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests reported here. We first apply Friedman tests [ 9 ] across the three agents, followed by paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests [ 46 ] comparing PIP against each baseline, and report matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation r r as the effect size. As summarized in Tab. G.3 , the Friedman tests show significant differences across agents for both sparse reward and preference rank. The paired Wilcoxon tests show that PIP significantly outperforms both GAMMA and GOAT on both metrics, with large effect sizes ( r ≥ 0.62 r\geq 0.62 ). Reported paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test values are uncorrected p-values, and all paired comparisons remain significant after Holm-Bonferroni correction across the four PIP-vs-baseline tests in Tab. G.3 . For preference rank, the sign of r r is oriented so that r > 0 r>0 indicates that PIP achieves a lower, better rank than the baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 由于每位参与者都评估了全部三种智能体，因此我们采用受试者内非参数检验并报告p值，而不是依赖标准误差棒在视觉上的重叠。主论文中人类评估图表（a）部分所示的显著性标记，对应于此处报告的配对威尔科克森符号秩检验。我们首先对三种智能体应用弗里德曼检验 [9]，随后使用配对威尔科克森符号秩检验 [46] 比较 PIP 与每个基线模型，并以匹配对秩双序列相关系数 r 作为效应量。如表 G.3 所示，弗里德曼检验表明，在稀疏奖励和偏好排名两个指标上，各智能体之间存在显著差异。配对威尔科克森检验显示，PIP 在这两项指标上均显著优于 GAMMA 和 GOAT，且效应量较大（r ≥ 0.62）。所报告的配对威尔科克森符号秩检验值均为未经校正的p值，并且表 G.3 中所有四项 PIP 与基线模型的配对比较，在霍尔姆-邦费罗尼校正后仍然显著。对于偏好排名，r 的符号方向设定为：当 r > 0 时，表示 PIP 获得的排名低于基线模型，即排名更优。

paragraphs.en: As a supporting analysis, we also test each survey category using within-subject nonparametric tests and report matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation [ 20 ] r r as the effect size, where | r | ≥ 0.5 |r|\geq 0.5 is conventionally considered a large effect. paragraphs.en: Overall, the human evaluation suggests that the proposed agent improves both objective and subjective aspects of human-AI coordination. Participants achieved higher sparse reward with PIP, selected it as the most preferred partner substantially more often, and gave it higher ratings across all survey dimensions. These results indicate that the proposed framework improves not only task-level coordination, but also perceived predictability, adaptability, role complementarity, and overall cooperation quality under ego-centric partial observability.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，人类评估表明，所提出的智能体改进了人机协作的客观和主观方面。 参与者在使用 PIP 时获得了更高的稀疏奖励，显著更频繁地将其选为最偏好的合作伙伴，并在所有调查维度上给出了更高的评分。 这些结果表明，所提出的框架不仅提升了任务层面的协作能力，还在以自我为中心的局部可观测性条件下，改善了感知到的可预测性、适应性、角色互补性以及整体合作质量。
